title: Some carried quest/lore items show a helpful parenthetical use-hint in the status/carrying list (e.g. 'gaunt rib-bone — the hunter might want to see it'), but others clearly meant for a specific NPC turn-in (e.g. 'a woven eel-trap charm') show no such hint, making it hard to tell which loose items still have somewhere to go.
